items.source: During application startup, Spring scans the classpath for domain classes for early processing of entities. By annotating your domain types with Spring Data-specific @Table, @Document or @Entity annotations you can aid initial entity scanning and ensure that those types are registered with ManagedTypes for Runtime Hints. Classpath scanning is not possible in native image arrangements and so Spring has to use ManagedTypes for the initial entity set.
items.translation: 在应用程序启动期间，Spring 会扫描类路径以查找领域类，以便对实体进行早期处理。 通过在您的领域类型上添加 Spring Data 特定的 `@Table`、`@Document` 或 `@Entity` 注解，您可以辅助初始实体扫描，并确保这些类型被注册到 `ManagedTypes` 中用于运行时提示。 在原生镜像配置中无法进行类路径扫描，因此 Spring 必须使用 `ManagedTypes` 来定义初始实体集。

items.source: fragment: Target fragment if the method call is delegated to a store (repository base class, functional fragment such as Querydsl) or user fragment. Fragments are either described with just fragment if there is no further interface or as interface and fragment tuple in case there is an interface (such as Querydsl or user-declared fragment interface).
items.translation: fragment：如果方法调用被委托给存储库（如 Repository 基类）、功能片段（例如 Querydsl）或用户自定义片段，则目标为该片段的片段。 若不存在进一步接口，则仅用 fragment 描述；若存在接口（例如 Querydsl 或用户声明的片段接口），则以 interface 和 fragment 元组的形式描述。

items.translation: 本章介绍构建在Spring 的提前优化（AOT）之上的 Spring Data 的提前优化（AOT）。

items.source: The resulting AOT repository fragment follows the naming scheme of <Repository FQCN>Impl__Aot and is placed in the same package as the repository interface. You can find all queries in their String form for generated repository query methods.
items.translation: 生成的 AOT 存储库片段遵循 `<Repository FQCN>Impl__Aot` 的命名方案，并放置在与存储库接口相同的包中。您可以在其中找到所有以字符串形式表示的生成存储库查询方法的查询。

items.source: AOT is a mandatory step to transform a Spring application to a native executable, so it is automatically enabled when running in this mode. When AOT is enabled (either for native compilation or by setting spring.aot.enabled=true), AOT repositories are automatically enabled by default.
items.translation: AOT 是将 Spring 应用程序转换为原生可执行文件的必要步骤，因此在此模式下运行时会自动启用。 当启用 AOT（无论是用于原生编译还是通过设置 `spring.aot.enabled=true`）时，AOT 仓库默认也会自动启用。

items.source: Set the spring.aot.repositories.enabled=false property to disable generated repositories for all Spring Data modules.
items.translation: 将 `spring.aot.repositories.enabled=false` 属性设置为 `false`，可禁用所有 Spring Data 模块中生成的仓库。

items.source: Set the spring.aot.cassandra.repositories.enabled=false property to disable only C AOT repositories.
items.translation: 将 `spring.aot.cassandra.repositories.enabled=false` 属性设置为 `false`，可仅禁用 Cassandra 的 AOT 仓库。

items.source: AOT repositories filter methods that are eligible for AOT processing. These are typically all query methods that are not backed by an implementation fragment.
items.translation: AOT 存储库筛选适用于 AOT 处理的方法。这些通常是所有不由实现片段支持的操作查询方法。

items.source:
AOT Repositories are an extension to AOT processing by pre-generating eligible query method implementations.
Query methods are opaque to developers regarding their underlying queries being executed in a query method call.
AOT repositories contribute query method implementations based on derived, annotated, and named queries that are known at build-time.
This optimization moves query method processing from runtime to build-time, which can lead to a significant performance improvement as query methods do not need to be analyzed reflectively upon each application start.
items.translation: AOT 仓库是对 AOT 处理的扩展，通过预生成符合条件的查询方法实现。对于开发人员而言，查询方法在其调用期间执行的底层查询是透明的。AOT 仓库会根据在构建时已知的派生、标注和命名的查询来贡献查询方法的实现。此优化将查询方法的处理从运行时移至构建时，从而可能带来显著的性能提升，因为无需在每个应用程序启动时对查询方法进行反射分析。

items.source: Consider AOT repository classes an internal optimization. Do not use them directly in your code as generation and implementation details may change in future releases.
items.translation: 请将 AOT 存储库类视为内部优化措施。切勿在代码中直接使用它们，因为生成和实现细节可能会在未来的版本中发生变化。

items.source: When AOT optimizations are included, some decisions that have been taken at build-time are hard-coded in the application setup. For instance, profiles that have been enabled at build-time are automatically enabled at runtime as well. Also, the Spring Data module implementing a repository is fixed. Changing the implementation requires AOT re-processing.
items.translation: 当包含 AOT 优化时，某些在构建时做出的决策会被硬编码到应用程序配置中。例如，在构建时启用的配置文件也会在运行时自动启用。此外，实现存储库的 Spring Data 模块也是固定的。若要更改实现，则需要重新进行 AOT 处理。
